biography.value: Not a shop so much as a counter beside the door, where the faithful leave coin and take away what the temple can spare. Healing draughts, holy water, a symbol to carry.

description.value: When rung as a Utilize action, a Bell produces a sound that can be heard up to 60 feet away.
A Lamp burns @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{Oil} as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 15-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet.

A Hooded Lantern burns Oil as fuel to cast Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. As a Bonus Action, you can lower the hood, reducing the light to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius, or raise it again.

A Book contains fiction or nonfiction. If you consult an accurate nonfiction Book about its topic, you gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) checks you make about that topic.
For 1 hour, a lit Candle sheds Bright Light in a 5-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 5 feet.
A Map or Scroll Case holds up to 10 sheets of paper or 5 sheets of parchment.

A Diplomat's Pack contains the following items: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagChest000000]{Chest}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.FqFmdzIBUSxFKKfi]{Fine Clothes}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagInk00000000]{Ink}, 5 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagInkPen00000]{Ink Pens}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagLamp0000000]{Lamp}, 2 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.items.Item.5mIeX824uMklU3xq]{Map or Scroll Cases}, 4 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagOil00000000]{flasks of Oil}, 5 sheets of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPaper000000]{Paper}, 5 sheets of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagParchment00]{Parchment}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagPerfume0000]{Perfume}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Tinderbox}.
A Flask holds up to 1 pint.
A Healer's Kit has ten uses. As a Utilize action, you can expend one of its uses to stabilize an Unconscious creature that has 0 Hit Points without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.

Usage Requirement: Worn or held

A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHolySymbolV]{Holy Symbol} takes one of the forms in the Holy Symbol table and is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.

Usage Requirement: Borne on fabric or a Shield

A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHolySymbolV]{Holy Symbol} takes one of the forms in the Holy Symbol table and is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.

Usage Requirement: Held

A @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHolySymbolV]{Holy Symbol} takes one of the forms in the Holy Symbol table and is bejeweled or painted to channel divine magic. A Cleric or Paladin can use a Holy Symbol as a Spellcasting Focus.

When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing a flask of Holy Water. Target one creature you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and Proficiency Bonus) or take 2d8 Radiant damage if it is a Fiend or an Undead.
Ink comes in a 1-ounce bottle, which provides enough ink to write about 500 pages.
One sheet of Paper can hold about 250 handwritten words.
One sheet of Parchment can hold about 250 handwritten words.
Perfume comes in a 4-ounce vial. For 1 hour after applying Perfume to yourself, you have Advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) checks made to influence an Indifferent Humanoid within 5 feet of yourself.

Potion, Common

You regain 2d4 + 2 Hit Points when you drink this potion.

Whatever its potency, the potion's red liquid glimmers when agitated.

A Priest's Pack contains the following items: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBackpack000]{Backpack}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagBlanket0000]{Blanket}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagHolyWater00]{Holy Water}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagLamp0000000]{Lamp}, 7 days of @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRations0000]{Rations}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagRobe0000000]{Robe}, and @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbagTinderbox00]{Tinderbox}.
A Robe has vocational or ceremonial significance. Some events and locations admit only people wearing a Robe bearing certain colors or symbols.
A Vial holds up to 4 ounces.

data.description:
Not a shop so much as a counter beside the door, where the faithful leave coin and take away what the temple can spare. Healing draughts, holy water, a symbol to carry.

Spellcasting here draws on the divine lists. How much the temple will part with in a day is finite: roll 1d4+1 slots in a village, 1d8+1 in a town, 1d12+1 in a city.
